story.zh: 曹操主力出征张鲁，合肥兵力空虚，孙权趁机率十万大军进攻合肥。
story.en: As Cao Cao's main army marches against Zhang Lu, Hefei's troops are sparse, and Sun Quan seizes the opportunity to attack Hefei with an army of one hundred thousand.
